precedents.case_name: Lord Krishna Sugar Mills v. Commissioner Sales Tax U.P.
precedents.cited_proposition: obligation to deliver goods outside Uttar Pradesh must arise from a term in the contract itself; despatch instructions given later do not incorporate into the contract to make it a sale for delivery outside Uttar Pradesh
precedents.cited_holding: A term in a contract that despatch instructions would be furnished later necessarily means that the seller undertakes to comply with them. If under a contract itself something is to be settled later, what is settled later becomes as much binding under the contract itself as the terms already settled under the contract. Still, I do not think that the sales in those cases in which the contracts provided for despatch instructions to be given later became sales for delivery outside Uttar Pradesh merely because the despatch instructions were that they should be despatched outside Uttar Pradesh.
